q1: SELECT b.name AS bar, COUNT(DISTINCT f.drinker) AS num_drinker, AVG(s.price) AS avg_price, (SELECT f1.drinker FROM frequents AS f1 WHERE f1.bar = b.name ORDER BY f1.times_a_week DESC, f1.drinker ASC LIMIT 1) AS most_reg_drinker FROM bar AS b LEFT JOIN frequents AS f ON b.name = f.bar LEFT JOIN serves AS s ON b.name = s.bar GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY num_drinker DESC, b.name ASC
q2: WITH BarStatistics AS (SELECT f.bar AS barName, COUNT(DISTINCT f.drinker) AS totalDrinkers, AVG(s.price) AS avgPrice FROM frequents AS f JOIN serves AS s ON f.bar = s.bar GROUP BY f.bar), Regulars AS (SELECT f.bar AS barName, FIRST_VALUE(f.drinker) OVER (PARTITION BY f.bar ORDER BY SUM(f.times_a_week) DESC) AS mostReg FROM frequents AS f GROUP BY f.bar, f.drinker) SELECT DISTINCT bars.barName, bars.totalDrinkers, bars.avgPrice, mrd.mostReg FROM BarStatistics AS bars JOIN Regulars AS mrd ON bars.barName = mrd.barName ORDER BY bars.avgPrice DESC
